layers.authority: Gobernación del Archipiélago de San Andrés, Providencia y Santa Catalina
layers.process: Visitors to the archipelago must buy a tourist card (tarjeta de turismo) at the airport they fly from, usually at the boarding gate on the day of the flight; the Gobernación's site also links to an online purchase portal (OCCRE). Tourists staying less than 24 hours and children under 7 are exempt.

layers.authority: Gobernación del Archipiélago (Decreto 0010 of 8 January 2026, as reported)
layers.process: The 2026 tourist card price is reported as COP 153,000 (about A$68.62 at the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia TRM of 30 October 2026 crossed via the RBA USD rate of 30 October 2026: A$1 = about 2,229.5046 COP), set yearly in line with the national tax value unit (UVT). Not yet confirmed on a Gobernación page.
